name: Kaba (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light blue at the hoist and white at the fly, with a notch cut into the bottom of the blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kaba: a green shield with a white arm holding a sabre.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
